audit.why: Ranged zoner whose turrets hold the lane; Aatrox cannot win a walk-up until the grenade is gone. Reaching him is the whole matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: UPGRADE!!! (R) is 100/85/70 and empowers his next spell — the upgraded CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E) is a far bigger stun. World Ender at 120/100/80 is the tool to walk through it.
audit.corrected: UPGRADE!!! (R) turns the grenade into a far longer stun on a 100s cooldown — that stun kills you, not the turrets. Hold World Ender to walk through the stun and reach him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E, 11s flat) stuns on a direct hit and slows around it — that stun, not the turrets, is what kills you. Infernal Chains and Q are ground-targeted so turrets do not body-block them.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Heimerdinger. Infernal Chains (W) drags him back to the centre if he doesn't leave the zone — save it for the moment you are on him, not for turrets. CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E, 11s flat) stuns on a direct hit: dodge that, not the rockets. Vs a ranged laner save E to close the gap, and pop World Ender to walk through the upgraded stun.

edits.before: Ultimate interaction changes all-ins. At level 6, reassess the matchup. Aatrox gains his ultimate, but Heimerdinger's ultimate or scaling pattern may change whether you can commit.
edits.after: UPGRADE!!! (R) turns the grenade into a far longer stun on a 100s cooldown — that stun kills you, not the turrets. Hold World Ender to walk through the stun and reach him.

edits.before: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Heimerdinger. W (Infernal Chains) roots him if he doesn't leave the zone: use it to lock him for Q2/Q3 or to cut off his escape. Vs a ranged laner, save E to close the gap or dodge poke — not for chip damage; you only win once you're on top of him. Pop R (World Ender) for the heal, AD and move speed when you fully commit or to survive UPGRADE!!! — never burn it for a single Q.
